history.war_summary: War 139 is on day 86 with no winner and conquest running; victory requires 32 towns. The front is split: Colonial holds full or near-full control in many regions (Acrithia, Allods Bight, Ash Fields, Drowned Vale, Farranac Coast, etc.), while Wardens hold others (Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Howl County, Reaching Trail, Stlican Shelf, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse). The heaviest pressure is in contested split-ownership zones—Clahstra (W 6/C 2), Callahans Passage (W 8/C 2), Godcrofts (W 5/C 4), Mooring County (W 2/C 10), Oarbreaker (W 5/C 4), Onyx (3/3), Olavis Wake (W 1/C 4), Speaking Woods (W 7/C 1), and Stema Landing (W 1/C 8)—with very high casualty rates and accelerating enlistments in several. Recent capture/flip activity is concentrated in Clahstra (21 events/24h, latest ~02:47), Mooring County (22 events/24h, latest ~00:46), Oarbreaker (22 events/24h, latest ~05:32), Stlican Shelf (26 events/24h, latest ~05:17), Endless Shore (8 events/24h), Morgens Crossing (4 events/24h), and Onyx (15 events/24h). Uncertainty remains high because several high-casualty regions (Callahans Passage, Dead Lands, Speaking Woods) show intense fighting but no recent event records, suggesting either stalled fronts or data lag; meanwhile accelerating enlistments in contested zones point to continued assaults over the next 24 hours.

The heaviest sustained pressure is in Callahans Passage, Clahstra, Dead Lands, Mooring County, Oarbreaker, Speaking Woods, and Stlican Shelf, where casualty rates are high and enlistments are accelerating. Recent ownership-flip activity is concentrated in Clahstra (21 events/24h), Mooring County (22), Oarbreaker (22), Stlican Shelf (26), Onyx (15), Endless Shore (8), and Olavis Wake (8), with the latest events within minutes at Oarbreaker and Stlican Shelf. Uncertainty remains high in split-ownership zones—especially Oarbreaker (5-4), Godcrofts (5-4), Onyx (3-3), Callahans Passage (8-2), and Mooring County (10-2)—where accelerating casualties and active base captures could shift strategic-base counts in the next 24 hours, while fully held regions show little near-term change risk.

history.war_summary: War 139, day 93, no winner yet (32 victory towns required). The map is heavily polarized: many regions are fully owned by one side with near-zero current combat (e.g., Acrithia, Dead Lands, Heartlands for Colonials; Reaching Trail, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse for Wardens), indicating stable rear areas. Active fighting is concentrated in a handful of contested regions: Oarbreaker (37 base events in 24h, ongoing flips at Posterus/Grisly Refuge), Clahstra (14 events, heavy accelerating casualties ~1,700/6h with Warden edge), Mooring County (18 events but quiet in last 6h), Stlican Shelf (17 events, casualties surging from near-zero to ~1,100/6h), Endless Shore (11 events, cooling from a spike), and Olavis Wake/Onyx (high casualty rates, recent activity). Callahan's Passage shows the highest raw casualty rates (~6,200/6h) but no recorded base events. Uncertainty: event feeds show zero events in the last 2h across all regions despite high casualty rates, suggesting either lull or reporting lag; history covers only ~11 hours, so trend durability is unverified; several hot regions' latest events are 10+ hours old.

War 139, day 89, no winner yet (30 victory towns required). The map is heavily polarized: many hexes are fully owned by one side with near-zero current combat, while fighting is concentrated in a handful of contested fronts. The heaviest active pressure is in Callahans Passage (~1k casualties/2h per side), Olavis Wake (~1.1k/2h), Dead Lands (~850/2h, warden-tilted losses), Speaking Woods (~750/2h), Onyx (~600/2h, evenly split at 3-3), and Clahstra (~880/2h). Base-flip activity in the last 24h clusters in Oarbreaker (26 events, ongoing as of 07:20Z), Mooring County (20 events), Clahstra (19), Stlican Shelf (20, though its last ~6h show sharp cooling after a big fight), Onyx (14), Endless Shore (8), Olavis Wake (8), plus smaller skirmishes at Tempest Isle, Morgens Crossing, Stema Landing, and Palantine Berm. Casualty rates across all hot zones show the same pattern: a large spike roughly 2-6h ago now cooling in the most recent hour, with enlistment inflows accelerating again — consistent with a lull between pushes rather than front collapse. Key uncertainties: only ~7h of event history is available; several high-casualty hexes (Callahans, Olavis, Speaking Woods) report zero base events despite massive casualties, so whether that fighting threatens strategic bases is unknown; and recent-hour cooling could mean either an operational pause or a completed push whose ownership effects have not yet been logged.

Clahstra and Stlican show near-parity combat with sustained activity; Oarbreaker has an immediate Fort Fogwood reversal; Mooring remains contested. Warden pressure is strongest in Oarbreaker and Stlican Shelf; Colonial pressure remains competitive in Clahstra and Mooring County.

The selected fronts are highly active and fluid. Clahstra, Stlican Shelf, Mooring County, and Onyx show repeated rapid reversals, while casualty ratios indicate a slight Colonial edge in Clahstra, Mooring County, and Stlican Shelf and a slight Warden edge in Endless Shore and Oarbreaker.
